name: webapptemplate
description: A webapp template that I use for everything - a python/flask backend with a node based HTML/CSS/JS front end

scripts.prebuild: npm run ensure-config && npm run clean
scripts.test:electron: npm run build && npm --prefix vscode-extension run sync-dist && npm --prefix vscode-extension run compile && npm --prefix vscode-extension run test:integration
scripts.test:workbench: npm run build && npm --prefix vscode-extension run compile && npm --prefix vscode-extension run test:workbench
scripts.test:harness: npm test && npm run test:webview && npm run test:electron && npm run test:workbench

author: Indrajeet Haldar
